puzzle.hint: The disbelievers falsely claimed the Prophet ﷺ composed this art form — but Surah Ya-Sin declares he was never taught it
puzzle.arabicVerse: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
puzzle.verse: 36:69 - And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān
